serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: The Vanta Trust Management Platform provides customers with an end-to-end security and compliance automation suite that focuses on the following activities: continuous and automated governance, risk, and compliance (GRC), vendor risk management, questionnaire automation, and up-to-date security program description displayed on the customers' Trust Center website. In addition, Vanta works closely with customers and selected audit partners to help streamline compliance against security compliance frameworks such as System and Organization Controls (SOC) 2, International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 27001, ISO 42001, National Institute of Standards and Technology Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (NIST AI RMF), CIS CSC, NIST CSF, FedRAMP, and more. Vanta serves as a continuous monitoring solution to ensure organizations reach and maintain a state of security.

certified.useCase: Underlying IaaS. Vanta operates compute (ECS Fargate, Lambda, Batch), networking (VPC, ALB/NLB, CloudFront, WAF, API Gateway, PrivateLink, NAT Gateway, Route53), data services (Aurora, ElastiCache, S3), messaging (SQS, SNS, SES), key management (KMS), configuration (SSM Parameter Store), container registry (ECR), and monitoring (CloudWatch, GuardDuty).
certified.justification: AWS is FedRAMP authorized and is the primary infrastructure for the product.
certified.mitigations: Account-level separation between production and non-production; VPC and subnet segmentation; deny-all / permit-by-exception traffic policy; PrivateLink for datastore connectivity; encryption in transit and at rest; GuardDuty intrusion detection across all accounts and regions
certified.compensatingControls: None are required because inherited controls are covered by AWS's authorization.

policies.policyName: Information Security and Acceptable Use Policy
policies.policyFileName: Information Security and Acceptable Use Policy
policies.policySummary: Company-wide acceptable use rules covering security reporting, device and data handling, BYOD, prohibited apps, passwords, AI tools, and referenced policies.
Ethical conduct standards covering legal compliance, conflicts of interest, insider trading, confidentiality, asset use, anti-corruption, and whistleblower reporting.

policies.policyName: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan
policies.policyFileName: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan
policies.policySummary: Continuity and recovery approach for production and business services, including dependencies, escalation, roles, call tree testing, and annual business impact analysis.
Four-tier data classification with minimum handling, labeling, AI data restrictions, retention, secure disposal, and legal hold requirements.
Personnel security controls spanning background screening, competence assessment, employment terms, security awareness training, and termination offboarding.
Inventory, ownership, acceptable use, return, off-site handling, secure disposal, and baseline workstation security requirements for Vanta assets.
Physical protection of offices and facilities including perimeters, badge entry controls, environmental threats, visitor management, and third-party physical security.
Defines security, privacy, and AI incident types, reporting channels, federal notification duties, response procedure stages, and incident response roles.

policies.policyName: Information Security Roles and Responsibilities Policy
policies.policyFileName: Information Security Roles and Responsibilities Policy
policies.policySummary: Assigns information security duties across the board, executives, GRC, legal, people, security, engineering, corporate engineering, and all users.
Explains how Vanta collects, uses, discloses, retains, and secures personnel data, plus DPF compliance, individual rights, and California privacy rights.
Vendor due diligence, contractual security requirements, ongoing monitoring, risk assessment, and baseline security control expectations for third parties.
GDPR and CCPA compliance program covering PII definitions, DPO duties, data protection, breach notification timelines, subject access requests, and compelled disclosure.
Secure operation of systems including hardening, anti-malware, backups, logging and monitoring, intrusion detection, and technical vulnerability management.
Security in the SDLC covering change and capacity management, AI-assisted code, version control, environment segregation, security testing, and test data protection.
Risk methodology covering register maintenance, categories, likelihood and impact scoring, treatment options, ownership thresholds, and the 3x3 risk matrix.
Least-privilege access management covering provisioning, deprovisioning within 24 hours, quarterly access reviews, privileged access, segregation of duties, and source code access.
Encryption requirements for restricted data at rest and in transit, approved algorithms, TLS minimums, and full cryptographic key lifecycle management.
Defines how Vanta identifies, scores, and remediates vulnerabilities, including scanning cadences, FedRAMP-aligned severity attributes, remediation SLAs, and validation requirements.

policies.policyFileName: Log Management and Design Standard v2.0
policies.policySummary: Sets requirements for log storage, retention, logging design, prohibited data, SaaS log ingestion, alerting, and daily/quarterly log review.
Sets secure development lifecycle requirements across design, development, testing, code review, CI/CD, and production security testing.
Requires production secrets encrypted at rest, keys managed in AWS KMS with rotation on compromise, and least-privilege access to secrets.
Requires an annual independent penetration test of the Vanta platform, remediation to SLA, retesting, and Trust Center publication of the retest report.
Requires GuardDuty-based intrusion detection across all AWS accounts and regions with alerts routed to a SIEM for monitoring and response.
Requires periodic, SLA-bound patching and review covering OS packages, containers, application dependencies, user applications, and software defects.

policies.policyName: Access Management Standard - Vanta App and Infrastructure
policies.policyFileName: Access Management Standard - Vanta App and Infrastructure
policies.policySummary: Governs ticketed, approved, MFA/SSO-protected access to the Vanta app and production infrastructure, plus quarterly reviews and 24-hour revocation.
Establishes Vanta's insider risk program: governance, risk indicators, monitoring, investigations, response, privacy compliance, training, and roles.
